description: Client-side script for auto-loading project items on scroll, handling review project filtering, and auto-submitting search forms in a web application.

methods.name: scroll
methods.description: Handles infinite scrolling to load more project items when reaching the bottom of the page.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles form submission for search, including adding review filter if applicable.

methods.name: change
methods.description: Automatically submits the form when input or select elements change.
